summary: Gildan Activewear filed a 6-K containing its Q3 2026 results press release, disclosing completion of the sale of HanesBrands Australia (HAA) on October 26, 2026; HAA had been classified as held for sale and reported as discontinued operations since Q4 2025. No transaction price, buyer identity, premium, advisor, or break fee is stated. Separately, the board approved a new normal course issuer bid to repurchase up to 5% of issued and outstanding common shares, and the company withdrew its 2026-2028 objectives, citing weaker demand. Watch capital-return execution and integration synergy realization (~$100M in 2026, ~$250M run-rate by 2028).
